{{Top|leg}}
The '''Curovao family''' was one of the [[Brentaal Houses]]. Both noble and rich, the family oversaw the city of [[Curovao]]. In some [[Time/Legends|time]], the city of Curovao became one of the largest cities on Brentaal, and the family used it to control much of its business during the times of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].

One of these businesses was [[Curovao ImpEx]], an import-export activity specialized in transportation of military commodities. During the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the Old Republic, the spokesperson of Curovao ImpEx was [[Aladaire Curovao-Simo]].

Due to Curovao working with experimental military technologies, it became a target for civil rights activists during the years previous to the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Brentaal Dissidents League]] protested against many of the dealings of Curovao and other [[Brentaalan]] corporations, claiming that Curovao achieved its profits by exploiting underdevelopment [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and peoples, crushing competitors and paying minimum wages. Corporate executives of Curovao, fearing for their lives, agreed to hire additional security forces to maintain their operations.
